output_list.criticism: The function transfer can cause an integer overflow if the balance of the sender is greater than 2^256 - 1.
The function transfer can cause an integer overflow if the balance of the receiver is greater than 2^256 - 1.
The function buy can cause an integer overflow if the balance of the contract is greater than 2^256 - 1.
The function sell can cause an integer overflow if the balance of the contract is greater than 2^256 - 1.
The function mintToken can cause an integer overflow if the balance of the target is greater than 2^256 - 1.
